name: Codex Build Visualizer
pitch: Turn agent traces, tool calls, file edits, builds, and tests into a privacy-safe interactive timeline and dependency graph.
wow: Drop in a JSONL trace and scrub through the entire build while files, commands, approvals, failures, and recovery events animate in sync.
mvp: Trace ingestion, strict redaction, timeline view, file/tool graph, failure markers, session replay, and static export.

name: Android Local Video Runtime
pitch: A model-agnostic Android runtime that lets users import legally obtained video models and run short generation jobs through GPU, NPU, or CPU backends.
wow: Import a model package, generate a short clip fully offline, and show live memory, thermal, latency, and backend telemetry on the phone.
mvp: One supported architecture, model manifest, user import flow, one backend adapter, 384×384 short clip pipeline, MP4 export, and benchmark screen.

name: AI Codebase Cartographer
pitch: Map an unfamiliar repository into architecture, ownership, dependency, risk, and change-impact views with evidence linked to source files.
wow: Ask “what breaks if I change this interface?” and watch the graph highlight affected modules, tests, owners, and risky call paths.
mvp: Repository index, symbol/dependency graph, cited answers, impact query, architecture map, and exportable onboarding report.

name: AI PR Maintainer
pitch: Triage pull requests, group review feedback, propose minimal fixes, and produce evidence-backed maintainer summaries without silently merging anything.
wow: Open a noisy pull request and instantly see a clean action board: blockers, duplicate comments, suggested patches, test evidence, and unresolved risk.
mvp: PR ingestion, review-thread clustering, patch proposal, test-plan generation, human approval gates, and final summary.

name: Test Failure Replay Studio
pitch: Convert CI logs and traces into a deterministic failure narrative that links symptoms, environment differences, suspected causes, and reproduction steps.
wow: Compare Windows, macOS, and Linux failures side by side and replay the exact divergence point in one synchronized view.
mvp: Multi-platform log parser, failure clustering, environment diff, minimal repro generator, and fix verification report.

name: Agent Memory Inspector
pitch: Make agent memory visible, editable, scoped, and auditable so users can understand what was remembered, why, and where it will be used.
wow: Open a session and inspect a live memory graph with provenance, confidence, expiry, conflicts, and one-click forget controls.
mvp: Memory event log, provenance links, scope controls, conflict detection, expiry policy, and safe export/delete.

name: AI Security Review Copilot
pitch: Review code changes against threat models, data flows, and repository policy while keeping every finding linked to concrete evidence.
wow: Select a diff and receive an attack-path graph showing source, trust boundary, exploit preconditions, affected assets, and a minimal patch.
mvp: Diff analysis, threat-model template, evidence-linked findings, severity rationale, patch suggestions, and regression tests.

name: Multimodal Research Canvas
pitch: Combine papers, web pages, images, tables, notes, and hypotheses on a spatial canvas with citation-preserving AI synthesis.
wow: Drag a chart and two papers onto the canvas, ask a question, and watch claims connect back to exact passages and visual regions.
mvp: Document/image ingestion, canvas nodes, cited synthesis, contradiction view, note linking, and shareable research snapshot.

name: Cited Document Copilot
pitch: Answer, compare, and draft from private documents while preserving page-level citations, uncertainty, and access boundaries.
wow: Ask a cross-document question and receive a claim table where every sentence opens the exact supporting page and conflicting evidence.
mvp: Private ingestion, chunking, cited retrieval, comparison table, uncertainty labels, and export with provenance.

name: AI Science Notebook
pitch: Turn experiments, data, code, plots, and hypotheses into a reproducible notebook with AI-assisted planning and claim tracking.
wow: Change one assumption and instantly see which results, plots, conclusions, and follow-up experiments become invalid.
mvp: Experiment records, data/code links, hypothesis graph, reproducibility checks, claim provenance, and report export.

name: Personal Knowledge OS
pitch: A local-first knowledge workspace that connects notes, files, tasks, and conversations without turning everything into an opaque chatbot.
wow: Ask “what have I changed my mind about?” and see a time-aware graph of notes, evidence, contradictions, and decisions.
mvp: Local index, linked notes, cited answers, timeline, memory controls, and portable export.

name: Browser Workflow Studio
pitch: Record, explain, edit, and safely replay browser workflows with explicit permissions, checkpoints, and human approval for risky actions.
wow: Demonstrate a messy multi-site task once, then watch the workflow become a visual, editable automation with live checkpoints.
mvp: Recorder, step graph, parameterization, permission model, dry run, approval gates, and replay log.

name: Meeting-to-Execution Copilot
pitch: Convert meeting audio and notes into decisions, owners, tasks, risks, and follow-ups while preserving who said what and requiring confirmation.
wow: End a meeting and immediately see a decision map, disputed points, owner-ready tasks, and a draft follow-up that links to exact moments.
mvp: Transcription import, speaker-aware decisions, task extraction, uncertainty review, confirmation flow, and export.

name: AI Incident Commander
pitch: Unify alerts, logs, runbooks, owners, and timelines into a human-controlled incident workspace that prioritizes evidence over confident guesses.
wow: During a simulated outage, watch the system build a live causal timeline, propose the next safest diagnostic step, and update the status page draft.
mvp: Event ingestion, timeline, runbook retrieval, hypothesis board, approval-gated actions, and postmortem export.

name: Open-Source Maintainer Dashboard
pitch: Prioritize issues, pull requests, releases, documentation gaps, and contributor health without replacing maintainer judgment.
wow: Open a busy repository and get a transparent weekly map of what is blocked, what is duplicative, what is risky, and where a new contributor can help.
mvp: Issue/PR clustering, stale-risk scoring, release readiness, contributor entry points, and cited weekly brief.

name: Adaptive Learning Coach
pitch: Diagnose misconceptions from worked steps, generate targeted practice, and adapt explanations without hiding the reasoning behind feedback.
wow: Write one wrong step and watch the coach identify the exact misconception, switch explanation style, then generate a near-transfer problem.
mvp: Step capture, misconception tags, explanation modes, mastery graph, targeted practice, and progress export.

name: Accessibility Copilot
pitch: Transform interfaces, documents, images, and live content into alternative representations tailored to a user’s access needs.
wow: Point a camera at a dense interface and receive a structured, navigable description with action targets, reading order, and optional voice control.
mvp: Image/UI understanding, structured descriptions, keyboard/voice navigation, preference profiles, and privacy controls.

name: AI Data Storyteller
pitch: Turn messy tables into verified metrics, interactive explanations, and decision-focused visual stories with reproducible transformations.
wow: Drop in a dataset and receive a narrated dashboard where every claim opens the exact calculation and source rows.
mvp: Schema profiler, cleaning plan, metric definitions, charts, cited narrative, and reproducible export.

name: Model Eval Arena
pitch: Compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, latency, cost, and failure modes on a versioned task set instead of relying on vibes.
wow: Run one dataset and watch side-by-side outputs, deterministic checks, human rubrics, regressions, and Pareto frontiers update live.
mvp: Task dataset, model adapters, run matrix, graders, trace storage, regression dashboard, and export.

name: Synthetic Data Workbench
pitch: Generate, inspect, filter, and validate synthetic datasets with explicit coverage targets, provenance, privacy checks, and human review.
wow: Move a coverage slider and watch the system generate missing edge cases while a live map shows diversity, leakage risk, and duplicates.
mvp: Schema builder, generation pipeline, deduplication, coverage dashboard, privacy checks, and versioned export.

name: Agent Observability Console
pitch: Inspect multi-step agent runs across prompts, tools, latency, cost, errors, approvals, and retries with searchable traces and replay.
wow: Click a failed answer and expand the exact chain of prompt, retrieval, tool call, retry, and policy decision that produced it.
mvp: Trace schema, ingestion, run list, step tree, latency/cost charts, failure clustering, and replay links.

name: On-Device Multimodal Assistant
pitch: Run useful text, image, and audio tasks locally with explicit hardware capability detection and graceful cloud-free fallbacks.
wow: Disconnect the network, point the phone at an object or document, and complete a useful task while showing exactly what stayed on device.
mvp: Capability probe, one vision task, one text task, optional speech input, model manager, resource controls, and privacy dashboard.

name: Voice Developer Console
pitch: Control a development workspace by voice while keeping commands inspectable, reversible, and confirmed before destructive actions.
wow: Say “explain the failing test, patch the smallest cause, and show the diff” and watch a live transcript, plan, commands, and rollback points.
mvp: Streaming speech, intent parser, command preview, approval gates, terminal integration, diff view, and undo log.

name: AI Creative Media Studio
pitch: A provenance-aware workspace for combining text, image, audio, and video generation into editable creative workflows rather than one-shot prompts.
wow: Turn a short brief into a storyboard, generate editable shots, compare variants, preserve prompt history, and export a complete asset manifest.
mvp: Brief-to-storyboard flow, provider adapters, variant comparison, prompt/version history, asset metadata, and export.
